def _approved(order, day):

def _revoked(approval, day, channel, revokes):

        if not channel_in(revoke["channels"], channel):

def to_utc(day, clock, basis, zone):
    """A service day plus a clock -> an aware UTC instant."""
    moment = parse_clock(clock)
    if basis == "utc":
        return datetime.combine(day, moment, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    if basis == "wall":
        return datetime.combine(day, moment, tzinfo=ZoneInfo(zone)).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    raise ValueError(f"unknown basis {basis!r}")


def _first_day(start, weekday):
    """First `weekday` on or after max(start, BASE_START)."""
    floor = start if start > BASE_START else BASE_START
    return floor + timedelta(days=(weekday - floor.weekday()) % 7)


def query(db, channel, start, end, asof):
    """-> [{code, day, utc}] for a channel over original Monday service days."""
    channel = str(channel).strip().upper()
    start, end, asof = as_day(start), as_day(end), int(asof)
    if start is None or end is None or start > end:
        return []
    try:
        series = _series(db)
        registered = _orders(db)
    except sqlite3.OperationalError:          # database never imported
        return []
    approvals = [order for order in registered
                 if order["kind"] == KIND_APPROVAL and order["version"] <= asof]
    revokes = [order for order in registered
               if order["kind"] == KIND_REVOKE and order["version"] <= asof]

    rows = []
    for item in series:
        day = _first_day(start, item["weekday"])
        while day <= end:
            candidates = [order for order in approvals
                          if order["code"] == item["code"]
                          and channel_in(order["channels"], channel)
                          and _approved(order, day)]
            candidates.sort(key=lambda order: (order["rank"], order["version"], order["id"]),
                            reverse=True)
            chosen = next((order for order in candidates
                           if not _revoked(order, day, channel, revokes)), None)
            if chosen is not None:
                service_day = day + timedelta(days=chosen["shift_days"])
                clock = chosen["clock"] or item["clock"]
                basis = chosen["basis"] or item["basis"]
            else:
                service_day = day
                clock, basis = item["clock"], item["basis"]
            moment = to_utc(service_day, clock, basis, item["zone"])
            rows.append((day, item["code"],
                         dict(code=item["code"], day=service_day.isoformat(),
                              utc=moment.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat())))
            day += timedelta(days=7)
    rows.sort(key=lambda entry: (entry[0], entry[1]))   # business day, then code
    return [row for _, _, row in rows]
